spec.name: zeb/potoru
spec.description: Potoru 2D animation for RWE templates: PotoPlayer (.poto player: canvas, slides, interactive stories, host bridge, viewer-chosen voices), PotoSnapshot (a still frame for thumbnails) and PotoEditor (YAML / Script editor with live preview) and compile() (in-browser compiler for Potoru sources). Offline; each part loads on demand.

0.1.note: Potoru web player 0.1.3 (with viewer-chosen voices: browser, Piper in WebAssembly from a site catalog, ElevenLabs and OpenAI-compatible with the viewer's own key) + format v4 compiler + authoring API (Potoru sources, Apache-2.0) via esbuild 0.28.1 with code splitting; lazy chunks, wasm engines, score-worker.js, potoru-authoring-sandbox.js and fonts/ sit next to the entry (new URL(..., import.meta.url)). Build: POTORU_SRC=<potoru>/designer/e3 node blessed/rwe-libraries/potoru/build/build.mjs (= esbuild --bundle --splitting --format=esm --minify --target=es2022 --outdir=0.1/runtime --entry-names=[name] --chunk-names=[name]-[hash] --out-extension:.js=.mjs entry.mjs, plus a worker build and an IIFE sandbox build; see build/build.mjs). Every file: FILES-SHA256.txt.
